title: C4InterFlow configuration
description: Configuration file (c4interflow.config.yaml) read by the 'execute-commands' command. Option names in 'commands' are the camelCase form of the long CLI option names (e.g. '--aac-input-paths' becomes 'aacInputPaths'). Relative paths are resolved against the current directory.

commands.description: The commands to execute, in order. Execution stops at the first failure. See commands-schema.json, which is generated by the 'export-schema' command.
